evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Central Eurasia, No. 132, 11 July 1994
evidence.snippet: …Moscow ITAR-TASS in English 1142 GMT 9 Jul 94 [By ITAR-TASS correspondent Anna Melnikova] [Text] Moscow July 9 TASS—“I hope that the current situation that has developed in North Korea in view of the death of its leader Kim Il-song will not lead to instability in that country but, on the contrary, will bring South and North Korea closer together,” Russian Presi- dent Boris Yeltsin stated at Vnukovo-2 airport on Sat- urday before departure for Napl…
